results.title: Matt Olson hits monumental HR, climbs Braves' all-time list
results.description: As the Atlanta Braves secured yet another win on Saturday, one of their team leaders and top players reached a milestone and moved up an all-time list.

results.title: Erisman rockets to PB in 800m free for third title
results.description: Ryan Erisman wrapped his USA Swimming National Championships performance with a personal-best time of 7:43.53 to win the men's 800m freestyle and bank his third national title of the week. The post Erisman rockets to PB in 800m free for third title appeared first on KTVZ .

results.title: Cooper DeJean walks out Morgan Wallen at Lincoln Financial Field
results.description: PHILADELPHIA — Cooper DeJean is accustomed to emerging from the tunnel at Lincoln Financial Field in an Eagles uniform. His latest entrance came under different circumstances.
